verdict.rationale: Render offers managed databases and key-value storage, environment variables, a single-YAML Blueprint for the whole architecture, and private networking. Its managed OIDC issues short-lived, auto-rotated identity tokens so services can call Anthropic and OpenAI without storing long-lived keys, which removes some credential wiring. However, nothing in the evidence shows a native binding model that injects datastore or storage clients into code; connections still appear to rely on SDKs plus environment variables. Missing for 10: documented native bindings or automatic injection of database/storage connections into code, explicit evidence that Blueprints wire datastore credentials into services, object-storage bindings, and independent hands-on corroboration.
